bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance across comparable bilingual benchmarks to demonstrate the mitigation of performance disparities and structural inefficiencies in an underserved language (Korean) compared to a dominant language (English).

Measuring the model's accuracy on localized, culture-specific knowledge benchmarks (e.g., CLIcK, HAE-RAE, and Korean-specific domain exams) to evaluate the mitigation of cultural blind spots typically found in English-centric frontier models.
